title: Multiplicity sits at the far end of each line
caption: One customer has many orders, an order has at least one line, and each line refers to exactly one product. The fields show how each multiplicity turns into code.

steps.text: Customer 1 ─ * Order: one customer has many orders (`list[Order]`), and each order has exactly one customer (a required constructor argument).
Order 1 ◆─ 1..* OrderLine: an order owns at least one line. Composition, so the lines die with the order.
OrderLine * ─ 1 Product: many lines can point at the same product, and each line refers to exactly one.
